entities.description: A black-and-white close-up portrait of a smiling woman with short, curly hair styled in a vintage updo, wearing a collared shirt and a pearl necklace. She is looking slightly upward and to the side with a warm, engaging expression, her teeth visible in a broad smile.

attributes.expression: smiling, looking up and to the side
attributes.pose: head tilted slightly, facing three-quarters toward camera
